name: case-file
title: Confidential case file
for_each: select id,ref as name from reports order by ref

sections.title: What was reported
sections.sql: select summary,protection_note,outcome from reports where id=$1

sections.title: Contact with the discloser
sections.sql: select on_date,direction,method,summary from contacts where report_id=$1 order by on_date

sections.title: Investigation actions
sections.sql: select a.ref,p.name owner,a.description,a.due_on,a.done_on,a.result from actions a join people p on p.id=a.owner_id where a.report_id=$1 order by a.due_on

sections.title: Who was told the discloser's identity
sections.sql: select i.on_date,i.told,p.name told_by,i.basis,i.note from identity_disclosures i join people p on p.id=i.told_by where i.report_id=$1 order by i.on_date

sections.title: Retaliation checks
sections.sql: select due_on,done_on,result,note from retaliation_checks where report_id=$1 order by due_on

name: board-report
title: Speak-up report to the board
for_each: select id,name from entities where active order by ref

sections.title: Summary, last 12 months
sections.sql: select v.name,v.jurisdiction,v.reports_12m,v.anonymous_12m,v.open_cases,v.substantiated_12m,v.policy_on,v.policy_review_due from v_entities v join entities e on e.ref=v.ref where e.id=$1

sections.title: Reports by category, last 12 months
sections.sql: select category,count(*) reports,count(*) filter(where finding in ('substantiated','partly_substantiated')) substantiated,count(*) filter(where status<>'closed') still_open from reports where entity_id=$1 and received_on>=current_date-365 group by category order by reports desc

sections.title: Open cases
sections.note: Reference, category and age only. Case detail stays with the case officer.
sections.sql: select ref,category,severity,status,current_date-received_on days_open from reports where entity_id=$1 and status<>'closed' order by received_on

name: policy-attestation
title: Whistleblower policy and procedures register
for_each: select id,name from entities where active order by ref

sections.title: Eligible recipients and case officers
sections.sql: select name,role,title,trained_on from people where active and role in ('officer','recipient') and (entity_id=$1 or entity_id is null) order by role,name
